items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017

ctx.x: And he would have said that about when, in the 60s?

I would say as late as the 1970s. And one of the biggest regrets, other than the fact that I lost my father, he died in ’72 I believe, was that he didn’t live long enough to see Barack Obama become president of the United States. Because he always used to tell me, “There’s no way in hell a black man is going to be president of the United States of America.” He would not have believed it. He would never have believed it. And I would have loved for him to have seen that. It’s like, “See, Pop, it did happen, Pop.”…
That’s what I started to gather, and partly why I wanted to talk to you.
